author: Digital Foundry
description:
Video sponsored by Continuum Entertainment.
Check out Outlive 25 on Steam, wishlist it and download the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948680/Outlive_25/

Outlive 25 is a full remaster of a cult Brazilian real-time strategy game that was perhaps overlooked on its release in Western markets back in 2001. In this video, Alex returns to the roots of the game and the environment it was developed in, while revisiting its 2D pre-rendered art - which was criticised at the time but explains how its visuals have aged gracefully over the years. So gracefully in fact, that the game still holds up nicely in the Outlive 25 remaster with its higher-resolution assets, widescreen UI, campaign tweaks and added content.
